strengths_deep_dive: UNRWA USA demonstrates strong financial stewardship, directing <cite id="12">95.2% of spending to refugee programs in FY2024</cite>. Their efficiency is further proven by spending only <cite id="12">$0.05 per $1 raised</cite>. Backed by <cite id="1">a 91/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>, the organization combines direct relief delivery with strong institutional trust.
rich_narrative.summary: UNRWA USA lifts up the voices of Palestine refugees and secures critical funds for humanitarian aid, healthcare, emergency response, and education [1, 13]. Operating in a high-urgency cause area, the organization recorded <cite id="12">$51,495,126 in total revenue in FY2024</cite>, reflecting substantial community support. The charity maintains <cite id="12">a 95.2% program expense ratio</cite>, directing the vast majority of its budget to direct service delivery and aid disbursements [12]. Furthermore, UNRWA USA holds <cite id="1">an overall score of 91.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and a <cite id="12">fundraising efficiency cost of just $0.05 per $1 raised in FY2024</cite>, underscoring its financial efficiency [1, 12]. The organization is <cite id="2">verified as Zakat-eligible</cite>, serving poor and needy populations (fuqara and masakin) in crisis regions like Gaza, the West Bank, and Syria [2, 13].
